content.comment_body: Hello, I am currently working on connecting a [product_name] project (11 modules) with Priva using MODBUS TCP to control lighting in a building. Previously, this was managed via the [product_name] engineering software, but our client now wants to operate it through the building management system (Priva). We are unable to establish this connection. Has anyone worked on integrating with Priva before? Best regards, [user_name]
Which [product_name] models are you using? Please provide the article numbers.
Are the [product_name] modules and the Priva system located within the same IP subnet?
Unfortunately, I am not familiar with Priva and cannot assist further.

You shared an image showing Priva using BACnet, but BACnet differs from Modbus TCP/IP. Are you certain Priva supports Modbus TCP/IP as well? If so, please share a link or upload a Modbus table for reference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to link multiple [product_name] devices ([version_no] mentioned) to a building management platform (Priva) via MODBUS TCP, after previously managing lighting through the [product_name] engineering software. Communication between [product_name] and Priva using MODBUS TCP is not successful. Responses highlight possible confusion between BACnet and MODBUS protocols, suggesting a protocol mismatch or misconfiguration. The lack of clear third-party integration documentation for [company_name] products is identified as a main usability challenge.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates easy, reliable connectivity and integration between [product_name] and building management systems like Priva through MODBUS TCP, along with clear resources or support for such processes.
